host.description: Host name for the application, like 'metabase.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

ldap_domain.description: Selected NS8 user domain for the LDAP login, empty when none

ldap_active.description: True when Metabase is started with the LDAP login of the selected user domain

ldap_schema.description: Schema of the selected user domain: rfc2307 (OpenLDAP) or ad

ldap_error.description: Why the selected user domain cannot be used: empty, ldap_domain_unavailable or ldap_proxy_unreachable

ldap_domains.description: User domains that can be selected

setup_complete.description: True when Metabase already has an account, false when its setup wizard is still open, null when Metabase does not answer

admin_pending.description: True while a configured first administrator waits for Metabase to be ready. The password is never returned

admin_email.description: Email of the pending first administrator, empty otherwise
